name: anything-obsidian
description: Local MCP endpoint for Anything Obsidian: one RAG search across every vault workspace, raw vault reads and vault management. Requires a running any-obs install (anything-obsidian start); defaults to loopback 21503 and can point elsewhere at enable time.

mcp_url.title: any-obs MCP endpoint
mcp_url.description: Anything Obsidian MCP endpoint URL. Default is this machine's local install; a custom value should point at the machine running any-obs (the server plane adds Authorization headers on top — see docs/agent-mcp.md).
